summary: Example Terraform config using ansible/aap provider (host and token, preferably via AAP_TOKEN) that creates aap_inventory, aap_group and aap_host, reads the 'Demo Job Template' with data aap_job_template, and launches aap_job with the new inventory; the job template inventory must be prompt on launch, and depends_on waits for host and group.
questions: How do I launch an AAP job from Terraform?
How do I create an AAP inventory and host with Terraform?
Why must the job template inventory be prompt on launch for aap_job?

answer_card.title: Launch an AAP job from Terraform
